q: A bowl of cereal with milk holds 45 g of carbohydrate, 10 g of protein and 5 g of fat. About how many kilocalories does it supply?

why.correct: Carbohydrate 45 × 4 = 180 kcal; protein 10 × 4 = 40 kcal; fat 5 × 9 = 45 kcal. Total 180 + 40 + 45 = 265 kcal... rounded to the nearest option, about 285? No: recheck. The sum is 265 kcal.
